description: MA Lighting grandMA2 onPC v3.9.63.6 — v3.9.63.6 under Wine in a Kasm 1.19 desktop container, with a persistent Wine prefix and host networking for MA-Net/Art-Net/sACN.
notes: Kasm Wine container (not a Windows streaming tile). MA Lighting software is licensed and is NOT bundled: download gMA2onPC_v3.9.63.6.exe from https://www.malighting.com/downloads/products/grandma2/ and drop it in the persistent /home/kasm-user/grandma-installers folder, then relaunch — the launcher installs it into the persistent Wine prefix and auto-starts it thereafter. Host networking is enabled for MA-Net2 UDP 6549, Art-Net UDP 8000 and sACN UDP 5568.
